notes.title: Major Stability Improvements Patch
notes.notes:
[b]🛠️ April 15 Patch – Stability Improvements[/b]

Since launching the open beta on April 10, we’ve been pushing updates twice a day to fix a lot of bugs. Thank you to everyone who’s helped us by reporting issues!

With this latest patch, we’re confident we’ve addressed some of the major crash causes. Multiplayer connections should now be significantly more stable, and single-player crashes should be much rarer.

[b]Bug Report[/b]
If you previously encountered crashes in solo or co-op, we’d love for you to give it another try. And if anything breaks, please send us your crash files and details via these two options :
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2Fpapercult]Discord [/url]
[*] [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc3H2pcpUwLI2BDMSg7sSgWuwD3mvGzzLphwWMf-Z1t3SycbQ/viewform] in-game bug report form[/url]
[/list]
Your bug reports and feedback are more valuable than ever!
[b]

🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] General optimization
[*] Fixed instability and crashes in multiplayer
[*] Reduced single-player crash frequency
[/list]
